title: GNSS
hintDrawerPanel:
Where the tracking panel is shown: on the left side of the map, on the right side, or not at all.

When hidden, you can still access the location settings from the Settings screen.
hintCenterMode: Keep the map centered on your GNSS position. You can pan away freely — after the configured delay the map flies back.
hintRecenterDelay: Seconds of stillness after panning away before the map returns to your GNSS position.
confirmDeactivateRecording: Track recording is active. Stop GNSS tracking?
permissionDenied: Location permission is required to use GNSS. Please enable it in the system settings.
